protocol_fix.problem: A keyboard release request following input-method deactivation caused wl_display.error invalid object 11 and disconnected the private input-method connection before harness cleanup.
protocol_fix.change: Destroy the local version-1 keyboard proxy without a wire release request. Preserve owning context destruction and all state/XKB cleanup. No ordinary inline/preedit enablement.
protocol_fix.regression_proof: One post-fix live KWin run exercised the previously failing deactivation path. No permanent automated regression test covers this protocol defect; the unchanged source-suite totals are not such coverage. A new fake-compositor harness was not added. Error matching is bounded observation, not proof of all future protocol behavior.
